title: How to Partner with a Tanzanian Miner & Invest in Gold — Legally
description: The Technical Support Agreement (TSA) gives foreign investors a legal framework to partner with PML holders, in compliance with Section 8(3) of the Mining Act, Cap 123 (2019).
